title: Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom
author: Kerberos 2
description:
Get The Mod On Steam: Expand the Required mods 💚 section below. Steam mods are unlisted, so you must come to this LoversLab page to get the link to them!!!

Join discord: <https://discord.gg/W4qkrNwUMk>

Subscribe to "Kerberos's Projects" under "Channels & Roles" on LazyIcarus's discord to get a ping when updates release.

Play as Alarielle in a new campaign. Resist or succumb to temptation as you battle through the new trials Slaanesh has in store. Take note, Alarielle has an easier campaign already, and this mod will bless the player with even more tools and bonuses. In return, traps have been laid to make for a more challenging campaign. If you are expecting an easy victory as Alarielle, N'Kari may have other plans...

Play as Slaanesh: New in version 2.0! experience the story of Alarielle's corruption from the perspective of N'Kari/Dechala/Masque or Morathi or Azazel+lords who confederate Azazel. The lewd scenes are all the same, but a lot of work was put into how to adapt the campaign to the Player as Slaanesh. If experiencing the story for the first time, I recommend playing as Alarielle, but if you really want to play as Slaanesh, then play N'Kari or Morathi. Lazy's Morathi progression is required to be used for playing as Morathi.

For those who want to know more about the content included, a LUA cheat sheet and flow chart is included in the downloads, though for obvious reasons the mod's content will be best enjoyed by experiencing it naturally in a fresh campaign.

If you only want the reskins and not the lewd campaign: You can you can load ONLY the kerberos_mod_assets.pack and then select whichever variant you like freely with variant selector.

Features

-
A highly curated campaign and story containing 48 distinct lewd scenes featuring high quality writing and art from numerous contributors (see "credits" section below).

-
The Legendary Handmaiden Vaeri, new and improved for this mod.

-
Immersively unlocked corrupted versions of Alarielle's faction mechanics, rites, equipment, and followers.

-
Immortal Empires portals (opened via corruption events) connecting Alarielle to the corrupted Worldroots.

-
Quest chains that allow the option for Alarielle to confederate Drycha, Sisters of Twilight, N'Kari, and Azazel.

-
Full integration with the Azazel's Realm mod. Confederating Azazel and starting Azazel's Realm quest lines for Miao Ying and Katarin becomes endgame content for Alarielle, but as you will see, this mod makes changes that shake up how you would normally play Azazel's Realm.

-
MCT options to control the pace of scenes.

Recommended mods 💛 + load order

[[SPOILER]]

Here is my full recommended mod list and load order for playing a lewd campaign with most lords including Alarielle. (hint: I never manually changed any load order) This is now linking to the wiki so I only have to update it in one place. 🙏I beg you to look at it, it's beautiful and I guarantee it will help you.🙏

<https://lewdhammer.miraheze.org/wiki/File:Mod_list_and_load_order.png>

Specific Recommendations (Some of the non-lewd mods are not in the above image)

Corrupted Wood Elf Units for Slaanesh <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3566849815>

My version of habu's corrupted wood elf units mod that adds support for High Elves, Kislev, Slaanesh, Warriors of Chaos, Morathi. It adds very thematic and useful units to landmarks added by Corrupted Landmarks. You MUST use this steam version and not Habu's versions. Use Habu's tdw_corrupted_buildings series of mods only when playing as Miao, turn them off when playing as Alarielle.

@n_SlaaneshVictories.pack

@n_SlaaneshVassals_Non_Slaanesh_Factions.pack

I did a lot of scripting to add support for these two specific Narok mods, you can now safely use these two specifically, and you will not get scenes from these mods telling you Alarielle is the Everwhore on turn 1 (or ever). The Slaanesh Victories events which add Slaanesh traits to the target female Lords will only trigger once Alarielle is Corruption Stage 5+. DO NOT USE THE n_SlaaneshVictories_Confederations version as using it to confederate quest target lords will break this mod and Azazel's Realm.

OvN Lost World <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3291116635>

(Requires Mixu's Unlocker) This mod is a must have. For Alarielle specifically, it changes Gaen Vale from a generic elven castle into the magical forest it was always supposed to be, which is very important to Alarielle's story. This also gives unique and loreful looks to important locations across Ulthuan, Kislev, and Cathay. This is a mod I will never play without again. This mod has campaign performance impacts. Basically you will freeze for a few seconds at the start of most turns and loading out of battles. If your rig is not modern, or campaign performance is more important to you than visuals, then consider skipping this.

Lin Corrupted Drycha <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3376933629> (+ English Translation pack from Lazy's Discord)

Great addition if you don't mind Nurgle content. When you confederate Drycha through my mod, Lin's mod will give you three very unique and thematic Nurgle corrupted legendary heroes as well, in addition to a landmark with some Nurgle daemon recruitment. I went to a lot of trouble to integrate this into Temptation's Bloom without making it a dependency.

Variant Selector <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2888171970>

Alarielle and Vaeri are fully set up to unlock variants as they progress, so you have the option to swap between variants that you have unlocked.

Legendary High Elven Characters <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2897366143>

This gives Alarielle access to Chief Handmaiden Lirazel and Aliathra the Everchild. These characters both feature in the story of Temptation's Bloom, and I have added some small easter-egg integrations for these characters.

Readman - Beautiful Bold Buildings <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3497485732>

Submod for Alarielle Temptation's Bloom this adds several corruption stage locked buildings focused on generating more Slaanesh corruption. This includes swap-able Industry Chain, Growth Chain, Ulthuan Gates, Great Bastion.

Readman Coalesced Character Creations <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3501984780>

Adds Readman's more lewd models for the Corrupted Sisters of Avelorn unit, and adds in 4 new Slaanesh Monster units with models by Soilofgenisis. (recruited from Corrupted Landmarks)

Readman Twisted Temptation Transformations <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3508604193>

Adds corrupted technologies for Tree Spirits and Daemons unlocked by Alarielle corruption.

Readman Upgrades Upon Unity <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3534460647>

Adds the Daemonic Ascension and boon mechanic for corrupting Handmaiden heroes. Great mechanic and great new Handmaiden models to go with it.

Readman also has different UUU versions to support play as Slaanesh. Only use one UUU version at a time! These allow you to recruit corrupted Handmaidens directly for:

Warriors of Chaos - <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3559919182>

Morathi - <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3557775008>

Daemons of Slaanesh - <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3558872079>

Lyra the Lioness: Legendary Hero <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2996269472>

Nymeria - Legendary Hero/Lord <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3404717872> (As a lord her name is blank)

Two female legendary heroes from Rat of the Lake who made Vaeri. Lyra the white lion has a slightly lewd model you can swap to with variant selector.

Unique Faction UI <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2789999718>

Always a value add, and required for the below recommended Slaanesh UI mod to be turned on at corruption stage 5.

in Temptation's Bloom you will see some odd duplication of the Defender of Ulthuan UI at corruption stage 5+ if you do not use it.

NOT Recommended mods 💔

[[SPOILER]]

Corrupted Ascension - This is currently completely incompatible with anything that relies on Lazy's Framework.

Any of Habu's tdw_corrupted_buildings mods - Habu's versions are designed for playing as Miao and can cause script breaks as Alarielle. None of them will add anything.

Recruit Defeated Legendary Lords (RDLL) - Turn off AI recruitment if used! There are many functions in Temptation's Bloom and Azazel's Realm that this will break.

SFO - Confirmed cause of CTD on Miao/Azazel quest battle. Also Temptation's Bloom new heroes and units will not be balanced.

Alarielle - wood elves campaign - Xakiroment's wood elf mechanics for Alarielle are already integrated into the base Temptation's Bloom in a Slaaneshified way. Having this mod turned on will cause a crash on launch. Also, DO NOT leave this mod or Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom enabled when playing as Wood Elves yourself.

[DEER24/震旦] 与龙同行 (Cathay Units Patch：Walk with the Dragon) - Causes script breaks apparent from turn 1 with context viewer.

Legendary Characters by Stratovarius - Causes script breaks visible with context viewer. These will silently soft-lock all corruption progression.

Lord Hero Swap - reported to prevent an Alarielle quest from triggering.

Miao Ying vs Slaanesh (Immortal Empires start positions) - Don't use anything that moves N'Kari's start position, he needs to stay in his Ulthuan start.

Morathi: Corruption of a Handmaiden - I don't recommend using at the same time as Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom even if you are playing as Morathi. It might work but will probably cause some unforeseen issues, as this mod was adapted for Alarielle.

Just Good Battle UI - causes the game to crash when entering a manual battle with Miao, if, and only if, she's corrupted.

Helper UI - same as "Just Good Battle UI" and confirmed cause of CTD on Miao/Azazel quest battle.

[[/SPOILER]]

How to start the mod + Required DLC ✔️

[[SPOILER]]

For play as Alarielle: It couldn't be easier, just follow the quests you will be issued from turn 1.

For play as Slaanesh: You will see a scene with Morathi and a handmaiden and be issued a quest on turn 1, then have a battle occur during the first AI turn. If you start as N'Kari or Dechala, you will be moved to a new start just south of Morathi. This will make more sense as you experience the opening story.

For confirmation that the mod has initiated properly, on turn 1 you can check the Kerberos_mod_log.txt located at C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Total War WARHAMMER III

Someone confirmed you can purchase the DLC after confederating the lord, and when you reload that save with the DLC, the lord will be in recruitment pool.

Starting map changes (the "Campaign" part) 🗺️

[[SPOILER]]

This mod makes quite a few alterations to the starting balance of the game at campaign start. I wanted to keep these mostly secret but people often discover and ask about them so I am finally documenting them here. These changes are made with two primary goals in mind:

#1, Ensure that Kat/Miao/Sisters of Twilight don't get wiped out by their AI enemies or each other before the player gets to interact with them as needed to complete the quest chains.

#2, Maintain a loreful and interesting challenge for the player. This is so that when you complete the primary quest chain, and have these strong (arguably overpowered) corrupted champions and items at your disposal, your final enemy will be a united and strong ordertide, which is a much more interesting "endgame" scenario than conquering an old world already ruined by Chaos/Skaven/Norsca/Vamps.

Starting Changes if player is Alarielle:

is removed from the game, in order to bring back in a controlled fashion for starting Azazel's Realm content.

Valkia is removed from the game, in order to bring her back in a controlled fashion for the endgame crisis.

N'Kari gets a boost to his starting army and province, Sigvald and Belakor get some starting buffs and start at war with Mistnar. (done in service of goal #2)

Tyrion and Eltharion get some buffs to their starting provinces to compensate for the above (and other reasons 🙊)

Miao and Katarin's starting provinces and armies are buffed. (done in service of goal #1 and #2)

Mother Ostankya goes back to Kislev. Yuan Bo goes back to Cathay. They get some free diplomacy with Kat and Miao (done in service of goal #1 and #2)

Confederate and abandon starting province for: Azhag to Wurzag, Arbaal to Archaon, Vilitch to Kairos. (done in service of goal #1 and #2)

Nerf the starts for Thrott, Ikit Claw, Grimgore. (done in service of goal #1 and #2)

Buff the start for Gor-Rok (done in service of goal #2)

Starting Changes if player is a Slaanesh aligned lord:

Everything above minus the changes to N'Kari and Azazel (if you are Azazel)

Alarielle starting strength is increased significantly.

Known issues / Troubleshooting 🛠️

[[SPOILER]]

TROUBLESHOOTING

If you encounter unexpected behavior, please report it in the relevant submod channel on Lazy Icarus's discord for troubleshooting steps if having an issue.

if you do not encounter expected behavior, Then please do the below for script troubleshooting (Yes, I put this in the page twice)

1) enable PJ's console from at <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2791241084> Console Commands (Modding Tool)

Check the box in game options for "Enable context viewer"

[img https://www.loverslab.com/uploads/monthly_2025_03/image.png.b56e9e1f25a28c70e97c7c83b7d9d9e9.png]

doing this will show script breaking errors in game for you as red text in the top left of the screen. Take a picture of these if you want help fixing your play-through.

PJ's console will also generate a log file called script_log_###.txt located at your install location such as C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Total War WARHAMMER III

Search this log file for: BIG FAT SCRIPT ERROR to identify what mods are breaking scripting for your game.

KNOWN ISSUES (If you can help fix any of these, I'll credit you)

The "rite" Extended UI: Sometimes messes up and you won't be able to scroll to the corrupted rites. If you had a lord selected when you opened the panel, un-select them. Closing and reopening the rite panel seems to fix this.

Confederation Names: Confederated corrupted Miao will lose her name. This has been a known issue with Lazy's corruption series and unfortunately would be very tricky to address due to how the game categorizes names by culture. There is a fix submod for this pinned in my Azazel's Realm discord channel you can enable after confederating Miao.

Eagle Mount: Alarielle's corruption stage model does not show on eagle mount during manual battles.

Sisters of Twilight Corrupted Model: Only 1 of the sisters has the corrupted model during manual battles.

Forest Spirit Upgrade Buttons

don't have these two buttons selected at the same time when trying to corrupt or add aspects to forest spirit units.

[img https://www.loverslab.com/uploads/monthly_2025_10/Untitled.png.0b6adf0f4236c451671a17c0915da1f1.png]

Slaanesh Authority for Alarielle: When confederating any corrupted lord as a Warrior of Chaos faction, you must trigger a first tick (load game or manual battle) after the confederation, and then end turn once. On the next turn their chaos authority will show and take effect correctly.

Corrupted Characters Stage Reset: You are using too many script heavy mods. run this bug fix mod with your modlist and load a save before they reset to stage 0. <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3509062568> (CA patch fixed this?)

FOR SUBMODDERS

In the LazyIcarus's discord channel for Alarielle Temptation's Bloom, there is a pin with a whole list of submod or nice to have ideas that I or others want added. If you are interested in contributing to the mod or dipping your toes in modding, this list could give you an idea for something to work on.
